$comment: A5 ratchet baseline. This is the CURRENT recorded set of files under plugins/tmux-teams/skills/tmux-teams/scripts/ that read a token's ledger straight off disk, per the definition documented at the top of scripts/ledger-reader-ratchet.mjs. Removing an entry (because a file stopped reading) is always allowed and tightens the ratchet. Adding an entry by hand is how a genuinely new reader gets authorized after review -- do it only after confirming the file actually needs to read a ledger directly, not to make a failing check pass.
